posts.en:
dsh-wsl-workspace-picker is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path input.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-bb3cd2e9b16194143bc3.html
